messages.subject: Problem Finishing Airline Dataset Example (3.4.1 Top 20 cities by total volume of flights)
parts:
Hello,

I'm running through the Airline Dataset Example given in the RHIPE
documentation. I was hoping to at least get as far as a graphing
example. Before I go any farther, please forgive my lack of
programming skills if this seems kind of obvious or something.
Hopefully, it isn't a major issue.

Anyways, I've gotten down to section 3.4.1, which is trying to graph
the top 20 cities. Everything, for the most part, seems to be working
correctly, up to this far in section 3 (I skipped section 3.3).

This is what I've typed in so far in R (relating to section 3.4.1):

map <- expression({
a <- do.call("rbind",map.values)
inbound <- table(a[,'origin'])
outbound <- table(a[,'dest'])
total <- table(unlist(c(a[,'origin'],a['dest'])))
for(n in names(total)){
inb <- if(is.na(inbound[n])) 0 else inbound[n]
ob <- if(is.na(outbound[n])) 0 else outbound[n]
rhcollect(n, c(inb,ob, total[n]))
}
})
reduce <- expression(
pre={sums <- c(0,0,0)},
reduce = {
sums <- sums+apply(do.call("rbind",reduce.values),2,sum)
},
post = {
rhcollect(reduce.key, sums)
}
)
mapred$rhipe_map_buff_size <- 15
z <-
rhmr(map=map,reduce=reduce,combiner=TRUE,inout=c("sequence","sequence")
,ifolder="/airline/blocks/",ofolder="/airline/volume"
,mapred=mapred)
rhex(z,async=TRUE)

counts <- rhread("/airline/volume")
aircode <- unlist(lapply(counts, "[[",1))
count <- do.call("rbind",lapply(counts,"[[",2))
results <- data.frame(aircode=aircode,
inb=count[,1],oub=count[,2],all=count[,3]
,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
results <- results[order(results$all,decreasing=TRUE),]

----

To this point, everything is working correctly (at least it appears
so). Then I try to execute this piece of code:

results$airport <- sapply(results$aircode,function(r){
nam <- ap[ap$iata==r,'airport']
if(length(nam)==0) r else nam
})

The error I get is this:

Error in FUN(c("ORD", "ATL", "DFW", "LAX", "PHX", "DEN", "DTW",
"IAH", :
object 'ap' not found

I've received this kind of error before (object '' not found) in
earlier pieces of section 3, and I was able to alleviate it by
changing the code a bit (I think it was some errors in the RHIPE user
guide given). However, here, I'm stuck. I'm not sure what to change/
add if anything. I'm hoping it's not something major. It doesn't seem
so.

Does anyone have any ideas? Again, if it seems simple, excuse my
ignorance. I'm just hoping to graph something, and I probably won't go
farther. I was hoping to demonstrate something graphically to my team.

Appreciate the help,

Jordan

If i'm not mistaken these lines in the code

results <- results[order(results$all,decreasing=TRUE),]

results$airport <- sapply(results$aircode,function(r){
nam <- ap[ap$iata==r,’airport’]
if(length(nam)==0) r else nam
})

library(lattice)
r <- results[1:20,]
af <- reorder(r$airport,r$all)
dotplot(af~log(r[,’all’],10),xlab=’Log_10 Total
Volume’,ylab=’Airport’,col=’black’)

The sapply call converts the airport code to a full airport name. I
think the website (which has the airline data) has the files
which have a mapping for lat/lon and airport code to airport name.

Regards
Saptarshi

I hope you don't mind helping me out, being a newb. If I'm getting
annoying or something, ignore the rest of this chain.

I'm running through more of the analyses section (3.4), and I'm
getting an error trying to plot the Proportion of Flights Delayed. I
was having some other bugs with the example code, so I changed it a
bit. I'm hoping this isn't the problem, but it works fine up until
creating the plot.

I've tried different minor variations, but here's the code that is
most similar to yours:

map <- expression({
a <- do.call("rbind",map.values)

a$delay.sec <- as.vector(a[,'arrive'])-as.vector(a[,'sarrive'])
a <- a[!is.na(a$delay.sec),]
a$isdelayed <- sapply(a$delay.sec,function(r) if(r>=900) TRUE else
FALSE)
e <- split(a,list(a$year,a$day))
lapply(e,function(r){
n <- nrow(r); numdelayed <- sum(r$isdelayed)
rhcollect(as.vector(unlist(c(r[1,c("year","day")]))), c(n,
numdelayed))
})
})
reduce <- expression(
pre={sums <- c(0,0)},
reduce = {sums <- sums+apply(do.call("rbind",reduce.values),
2,sum)},

post = { rhcollect(reduce.key, sums) }
)

mapred <- list()
mapred$rhipe_map_buff_size <- 5

z <-
rhmr(map=map,reduce=reduce,combiner=TRUE,inout=c("sequence","sequence")

,ifolder="/airline/blocks/",ofolder="/airline/delaybyyear"
,mapred=mapred)
z=rhex(z)

b <- rhread("/airline/delaybyyear")
y1 <- do.call("rbind",lapply(b,"[[",1))
y2 <- do.call("rbind",lapply(b,"[[",2))
results <- data.frame(year=1900+as.numeric(y1[,1]),day=y1[,2],
nflight=y2[,1],ndelay=y2[,2])
results$prop <- results$ndelay/results$nflight
results <- results[order(results$year,results$day),]

prop <- results[,'prop']
prop <- prop[!is.na(prop)]
tprop <- ts(log(prop/(1-prop)),start=c(1987,273),frequency=365)
pdf("~/tmp/propdelayedxyplot.pdf")
plot(stl(tprop,s.window="periodic"))
dev.off()

---

I don't think pdf("~/tmp/propdelayedxyplot.pdf") is necessary--it's
probably what you were talking about earlier. Also the code:

results <- data.frame(year=1900+as.numeric(y1[,1]),day=y1[,2],
nflight=y2[,1],ndelay=y2[,2])

I added as.numeric() because otherwise I was getting this error:

Error in 1900 + y1[, 1] : non-numeric argument to binary operator

Anyways, with my changes and trying plot() at the end, I get this
error:

Error in stl(tprop, s.window = "periodic") :
series is not periodic or has less than two periods

I'm not really sure what to do with that.
